_note: kind: room = pressurised (atmosphere graph via corridors); exterior = outdoor (power/water via cables); special; link. Base fields are the SIZE M values (v1 behaviour). 'sizes' gives per-size arrays [S, M, L, XL] that override base fields; fields not listed scale with balance.json size multipliers (cost, power, construction work). levels: true = can be upgraded to L2..L5 (balance.json 'levels'); level_stat names the base field that scales with level. family: which tier-5 special research unlocks level 5. research: tech that unlocks the structure ('' = start). automatic: works without staff. silhouette: art brief for the Blender generators. See docs/AAA_DESIGN.md section 2.

lander.name: Lander
lander.desc: Emergency shelter and cargo. Its air is self-contained and ends after three days. Carriers reach the cargo bay from outside.
lander.silhouette: squat capsule on four legs with foot pads, ramp on +X, antenna

solar_array.name: Solar Array
solar_array.desc: Makes power in daylight. Zero at night.
solar_array.silhouette: tilted blue panel rows on dark frames; S one panel, M two rows, L four rows, XL a field with a tracker mast

wind_turbine.name: Wind Turbine
wind_turbine.desc: Makes power from the wind, day and night.
wind_turbine.silhouette: slender mast, nacelle, three blades (Rotor object); mast height grows with size

battery.name: Battery Bank
battery.silhouette: rows of battery cabinets on a skid with cooling fins and status lights; more rows for bigger sizes

water_extractor.name: Water Extractor
water_extractor.desc: Pumps water into the reservoirs on its network.
water_extractor.silhouette: lattice drill rig over a wellhead, pump body, blue pipes; XL has two rigs

reservoir.name: Reservoir
reservoir.silhouette: horizontal tank on cradles with a level stripe; L two tanks; XL a sphere on legs

oxygen_plant.name: Oxygen Plant
oxygen_plant.desc: Makes oxygen from water. Fills every room joined to it by corridors.
oxygen_plant.silhouette: dome with glass panels and electrolysis stacks rising through the roof; stack count grows with size

airlock.name: Airlock
airlock.desc: The door between the base and the outside. Two people per ten-second cycle. Suits refill here.
airlock.silhouette: armoured drum, heavy door frame with hazard stripes on +X

habitat.name: Habitat
habitat.desc: Beds and a drinking-water tap. Higher levels give more comfort (morale).
habitat.silhouette: dome with round portholes; L and XL add a second deck ring and a skylight

kitchen.name: Kitchen & Mess
kitchen.desc: An operator cooks dishes from crops. Better levels cook better dishes. Colonists eat here.
kitchen.silhouette: dome with an extractor chimney and a service hatch; dining tables inside

greenhouse.name: Greenhouse
greenhouse.desc: Crop trays. Growers seed and harvest. Each tray needs power and water without long breaks.
greenhouse.silhouette: geodesic glass dome with frame ribs over crop trays and grow lights

storehouse.name: Storehouse
storehouse.desc: Holds goods. Fresh food spoils here; cold storage keeps it.
storehouse.silhouette: wide low drum with a loading hatch; L and XL add silos around it

mine.name: Mine
mine.desc: Place on a mineral deposit. Operators dig ore.
mine.silhouette: dome with a lattice headframe and winch wheel through the roof, ore hopper on the side

refinery.name: Refinery
refinery.desc: A technician turns 2 ore into 1 steel.
refinery.silhouette: industrial shed on a round base with a furnace and a tall chimney

polymer_plant.name: Polymer Plant
polymer_plant.desc: A technician turns 2 biomass into 1 polymer.
polymer_plant.silhouette: round vats with domed lids and pipe racks over the roof

medical.name: Medical Bay
medical.desc: Treatment beds. Hurt colonists heal fast here. Medicine doubles healing.
medical.silhouette: white dome with a large red cross on the roof and a scanner arch inside

lounge.name: Lounge
lounge.desc: Recreation places. 60 seconds a day keeps morale up.
lounge.silhouette: panorama glass dome with curved sofas and planters

workshop.name: Workshop
workshop.desc: A technician makes spare parts from steel and polymer.
workshop.silhouette: shed with a roof crane arm and a parts rack

landing_pad.name: Landing pad
landing_pad.desc: One visiting ship. Trade and immigration arrive here.
landing_pad.silhouette: flat round pad, painted ring, edge lights, control kiosk

junction.name: Junction
junction.desc: A small hub. Use it where corridors must cross or branch.

corridor.name: Corridor
corridor.desc: Joins two rooms. Carries people, power, water and air.

cable.name: Utility cable
cable.desc: Joins two structures. Carries power and water. No air, no walking.

research_lab.name: Research Lab
research_lab.silhouette: stacked hexagonal pods on the round base and an observatory dome with a slit and telescope
research_lab.desc: Scientists turn work into research points.

glassworks.name: Glassworks
glassworks.silhouette: kiln dome with a short glowing stack and a cooling bed of glass sheets
glassworks.desc: A technician melts 2 silicate into 1 glass.

electronics_fab.name: Electronics Fab
electronics_fab.silhouette: clean-room block on the round base with ducts, filters and a blue-lit window band
electronics_fab.desc: A technician makes electronics from silicate and steel.

fabricator.name: Fabricator
fabricator.silhouette: tall hall with a gantry arm and rolling doors, hull plates stacked outside
fabricator.desc: Hull plates and composite panels. Choose the recipe.

fungus_farm.name: Fungus Farm
fungus_farm.silhouette: dark ribbed dome, no glass, violet grow strips, stacked mushroom racks at the tray places
fungus_farm.desc: Grows mushrooms in the dark. Little power and water.

algae_bioreactor.name: Algae Bioreactor
algae_bioreactor.silhouette: ring of tall glowing green glass tubes around a central core, pipes at the top
algae_bioreactor.desc: Grows algae without staff and adds some oxygen to its rooms.

water_recycler.name: Water Recycler
water_recycler.silhouette: drum with a ring of filter columns and blue piping, small vent stack
water_recycler.desc: Returns used water to the network. Up to half of what the network uses.

atmo_processor.name: Atmosphere Processor
atmo_processor.silhouette: two hyperbolic cooling towers on a round base, intake grilles, vapour vents
atmo_processor.desc: Makes oxygen from the thin air outside. Uses power, no water.

bio_lab.name: Bio-Lab
bio_lab.silhouette: cluster of three white pods on the round base, green cross, fume stack
bio_lab.desc: A medic makes medicine from herbs and polymer.

cantina.name: Cantina
cantina.silhouette: dome with a glowing neon sign, a terrace canopy and a bar counter inside
cantina.desc: More recreation places. Colonists who relax here get a morale bonus.

cold_storage.name: Cold Storage
cold_storage.silhouette: frosted drum with radiator fins and a heavy insulated door
cold_storage.desc: Stores goods. Food here does not spoil.

regolith_harvester.name: Regolith Harvester
regolith_harvester.silhouette: tracked crawler with a front scoop, conveyor and hopper
regolith_harvester.desc: Scoops silicate sand anywhere on flat ground. No staff.

fuel_refinery.name: Fuel Refinery
fuel_refinery.silhouette: two spherical tanks and a tall cracking column with hazard stripes
fuel_refinery.desc: Makes rocket fuel from network water (4 water per fuel). No staff.

deep_drill.name: Deep Core Drill
deep_drill.silhouette: tall derrick (14 m) with a drill string and a crystal separator
deep_drill.desc: Place on a mineral deposit. Brings up exotic crystals slowly. No staff.

fusion_reactor.name: Fusion Reactor
fusion_reactor.silhouette: torus of magnet coils around a glowing plasma core, two radiator wings
fusion_reactor.desc: Makes 60 P day and night. Uses 5 water a day.

comms_tower.name: Comms Tower
comms_tower.silhouette: tall lattice mast (22 m) with a dish and blinking beacons
comms_tower.desc: Talks to orbit. Research +10%. Needed for Meridian supply runs.

meridian.name: The Meridian
meridian.silhouette: crashed 42 m colony ship on its belly, nose half buried, hull breaches, two engine pods (see AAA_DESIGN section 9)
meridian.desc: The colony ship that crashed on the way down. Repair it to fly again.
